description: A blast furnace cooks five raw gold; shift-clicking the ingots out gives 5 experience at the player (three orbs, level 0 with the official progress), putting them back none; a grindstone takes Efficiency III off an iron pickaxe and gives 11 to 21 experience (its amount draws from the level random) to the player standing on it; Circuit and both official servers give identical windows, pickups and experience
